question: Should OpenClaw accept purpose-specific memory role slots as core config/plugin API, using https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/88504 as the canonical implementation path?
rationale: Current main and the latest release still expose one exclusive memory slot, but changing it adds public config/API surface and migration obligations that automation should not decide.

options.title: Review linked role-slot PR
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/88504 as the canonical implementation candidate and decide taxonomy, compatibility, and proof there before closing this issue.

options.title: Narrow taxonomy first
options.body: Keep this issue open as design work and ask the PR to reduce, rename, or stage role slots before public config surface lands.

options.title: Reject core role slots
options.body: Keep one active memory slot and close this direction only if maintainers decide memory composition should stay outside core or use a different plugin API shape.

recommendation.title: Review linked role-slot PR
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/88504 as the canonical implementation candidate and decide taxonomy, compatibility, and proof there before closing this issue.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision changes OpenClaw public config/plugin API direction, and steipete is both the listed project decision owner and part of the memory-slot history.
